subject: general
question:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

ZA_J, B_BK, DAB_, _ABM, HA_N
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The first letter is increasing by 2 and the fourth letter is increasing by 1 in each subsequent term. There is no change in the second and third letter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39c9c9a93942b0da153d41e2816d924c90a8178997fe3bb11862cc41c38a18c6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****BALFB"**.
